{{Quote|I be admirin' the bravery of 'dem pirates. Kidnappin' nobles, keepin' 'em locked up fer ransom. Hmm.. I bet yer hankerin' ta find where they be keepin' dem nobles.|Ketter Yaaran, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KY" />}}
'''Ketter Yaaran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he frequented the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaadara]]. While there, Yaaran once supplied the whereabouts of a [[Naboo pirates|pirate]] [[Pirate Bunker|bunker]] in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] interested in rescuing kidnapped nobles.<ref name="SWG:KY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ketter Yaaran was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KY" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ketter Yaaran was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
